title: crotalaria sessiliflora var. anthylloides
intro: Crotalaria sessiliflora var. anthylloides, commonly known as a plant species, is a type of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Crotalaria sessiliflora var. anthylloides include anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties, which help to reduce inflammation and fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
